result.title: DictaRashi: A State-of-the-Art OCR Model For Rashi Script
result.summary: We release DictaRashi, a Tesseract OCR model for scanned Hebrew books printed in the so-called "Rashi" font. We trained DictaRashi on over one million manually corrected lines of text from over 100 different books of Rabbinic and post-Rabbinic literature. On a held-out set of 1,120 manually transcribed lines from scanned Rashi-script pages, DictaRashi reaches a character error rate (CER) of 0.86% and a word error rate (WER) of 3.38%, setting a new state-of-the-art for publicly-available Tesseract models. We provide a full comparison of our results to those of the 31 other publicly available Hebrew Tesseract models; the best of those models achieves a 2.98% CER and 11.86% WER. We further demonstrate that DictaRashi outperforms the current frontier LLMs on this OCR task. We release the test set of Rashi-script documents so that it may be used as a benchmark for future work in this area. We are pleased to release the model and test set to the community under a CC BY NC 4.0 license.

AI.brief_summary: 发布面向希伯来文「Rashi」字体的 Tesseract OCR 模型及测试集，在人工转写行上取得 0.86% CER / 3.38% WER，并称优于现有公开模型与前沿 LLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯 OCR 识别模型与基准发布，目标是把扫描字符转成文本，不涉及推理状态生成、视觉证据筛选或 latent 表示的使用，缺少可供核查的方法借鉴线索。
